/- E5 preamble for softmax: fixed by the loop, prepended to the agent's `Laws.lean`. Do not edit. -/
open Std Lean.Grind

/-- An exponential, as an opaque primitive. -/
class HasExp (F : Type) where
  exp : F → F

/-- The facts about `exp` a proof may use. -/
class ExpLaws (F : Type) [Field F] [LT F] [HasExp F] where
  exp_pos : ∀ x : F, 0 < HasExp.exp x
  exp_add : ∀ x y : F, HasExp.exp (x + y) = HasExp.exp x * HasExp.exp y
  exp_inj : ∀ x y : F, HasExp.exp x = HasExp.exp y → x = y

namespace E5

open HasExp

/-- Σ_j exp x_j. -/
def partition {F : Type} [Field F] [HasExp F] (xs : List F) : F := (xs.map exp).sum

/-- Row-wise softmax: the task's function on one row. -/
def softmaxRow {F : Type} [Field F] [HasExp F] (xs : List F) : List F :=
  xs.map (fun x => exp x / partition xs)

variable {F : Type} [Field F] [LE F] [LT F] [LawfulOrderLT F] [IsLinearOrder F] [OrderedRing F] [HasExp F] [ExpLaws F]

def Laws (f : List F → List F) : Prop :=
  (∀ xs, (f xs).length = xs.length) ∧
  (∀ xs, ∀ y ∈ f xs, 0 ≤ y) ∧
  (∀ xs, xs ≠ [] → (f xs).sum = 1) ∧
  (∀ xs, ∀ p ∈ xs.zip (f xs), ∀ q ∈ xs.zip (f xs),
      p.2 * HasExp.exp q.1 = q.2 * HasExp.exp p.1) ∧
  (∀ xs (c : F), f (xs.map (· + c)) = f xs)

theorem sum_exp_nonneg : ∀ xs : List F, 0 ≤ (xs.map HasExp.exp).sum
  | [] => by
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
    grind
  | x :: t => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have h1 : 0 < HasExp.exp x := ExpLaws.exp_pos x
    have h2 := sum_exp_nonneg t
    grind

theorem sum_exp_pos (x : F) (t : List F) : 0 < ((x :: t).map HasExp.exp).sum := by
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
  have h1 : 0 < HasExp.exp x := ExpLaws.exp_pos x
  have h2 := sum_exp_nonneg t
  grind

theorem aux_sum (a b : F) : ∀ (xs ys : List F), xs.length = ys.length →
    (∀ q ∈ xs.zip ys, b * HasExp.exp q.1 = q.2 * HasExp.exp a) →
    b * (xs.map HasExp.exp).sum = ys.sum * HasExp.exp a
  | [], [], _, _ => by
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
    grind
  | [], _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => by simp at h
  | x :: xs, y :: ys, h, hp => by
    have h1 : b * HasExp.exp x = y * HasExp.exp a := hp (x, y) (by simp)
    have h2 := aux_sum a b xs ys (by simpa using h) (fun q hq => hp q (by simp [hq]))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    grind

theorem fin_aux (Z : F) (hZ : Z ≠ 0) : ∀ (xs ys : List F), xs.length = ys.length →
    (∀ p ∈ xs.zip ys, p.2 * Z = HasExp.exp p.1) →
    ys = xs.map (fun x => HasExp.exp x / Z)
  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, [], h, _ => by simp at h
  | x :: xs, y :: ys, h, hp => by
    have h1 : y * Z = HasExp.exp x := hp (x, y) (by simp)
    have h2 := fin_aux Z hZ xs ys (by simpa using h) (fun p hq => hp p (by simp [hq]))
    have h3 : y = HasExp.exp x / Z := by grind
    simp only [List.map_cons]
    rw [h2, h3]

theorem uniqueness (f : List F → List F) (h : Laws f) (xs : List F) (hne : xs ≠ []) :
    f xs = softmaxRow xs := by
  unfold Laws at h
  obtain ⟨hlen, _, hsum, hrat, _⟩ := h

28	    m = _malformed(x, y)
29	    if m is not None:
30	        return False, m
31	    y64 = y.astype(np.float64)
32	    if not bool(np.all(y64 >= 0.0)):
33	        return False, "negative entry"

39	def sums_to_one(x, y):
40	    m = _malformed(x, y)
41	    if m is not None:
42	        return False, m
43	    cols = x.shape[1]
44	    tol = 2e-5 + 0.5 * EPS * cols
45	    s = y.astype(np.float64).sum(axis=1)
46	    err = np.abs(s - 1.0)
47	    if not bool(np.all(err <= tol)):
48	        return False, "row sum off by %.3g (tol %.3g)" % (float(np.max(err)), tol)
49	    return True, "ok"

52	def ratio_law(x, y):
53	    # y_i / y_j = exp(x_i - x_j): log y_i - x_i must be the same for every entry of a row.
54	    m = _malformed(x, y)
55	    if m is not None:
56	        return False, m
57	    x64 = x.astype(np.float64)
58	    y64 = y.astype(np.float64)
59	    rows = x.shape[0]
60	    mx = x64.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
61	    d = np.minimum(np.abs(x64 - mx), DCAP)
62	    ref = np.argmax(y64, axis=1)
63	    idx = np.arange(rows)
64	    yref = y64[idx, ref]

66	        return False, "row has no non-negligible entry"
67	    valid = y64 > TINY
